name: The Herald of Tomorrow
source:
Cole Forrester is one of VersaPharm's top biologists. His goal is to complete  BioStasis; a breakthrough technology that could save people on the verge of death. No matter how long he's worked on the project, he and his team haven't made any progress for months, and this has greatly impacted Cole's mental health. In the events of the game, Cole faces challenges that put everything he knows at risk. Will he fight for himself and those he loves, or will despair consume him?
